note: The agent eval bar: the rows one AG1 scorecard run printed, read by tools/eval-bar.mjs. It adds no threshold of its own: a card line below a row here is red and a lost row is red, the same rule `Scorecard::reds` applies to the last card. A row with total 0 (BreakBench today) is unbuilt and skipped. Re-measure by running the command below and copying the card rows into `rows`.
command: node tools/gh-check.mjs cargo test -p engine-playtest --lib scorecard_command -- --ignored --nocapture
backend: mock only: every suite replays a recorded tape through the provider contract, no network and no API key
